  1. 1.dr-kb__barThe accessory bar: 44 tall on --bg-surface, a 1px --border-hairline on top. HIG's 44pt floor.
  2. 2.dr-kb__doneThe one real control: a <button>, 15/600 in --text-primary, 44 tall, padding 0 12, at the bar's trailing edge. A multiline field's Return inserts a newline and cannot dismiss, so Done does.
  3. 3.dr-kb__planeThe keys' plane: 291 in the build (216 keys + 45 QuickType + 30 home-indicator inset), aria-hidden, no pointer target. Scaled to fit here.
  4. 4.dr-kb__quickThe QuickType strip, 45 tall, drawn as three empty cells split by 18px hairlines.
  5. 5.dr-kb__key--modA modifier key (⇧, ⌫, 123, ☺) on --bg-surface with a 12px label, 14.37:1; letter keys are --bg-page on the --bg-muted plane with a 22px label in --text-primary, 15.99:1. Radius 5.

The accessory bar's Done, the one real control; the keys are aria-hidden.

When to use

The keyboard is the frame's third piece of system chrome, beside the status bar and the home indicator. It depicts what iOS draws over an app; the product does not own it. ui/kit.js builds it on the pages that carry a field, so no page writes its markup: 26 pages, every one that loads ui/kit.js and holds a text field or text area. The specimens on this page are the markup it builds. It rises only while the viewport switcher says mobile: 291 is quoted from a phone in portrait, a tablet is an iPad and a desktop has a hardware keyboard.

While the keys are up the action bar takes [hidden] and a tab root sheds its tab bar, so no control sits behind the plane while still in the tab order (WCAG 2.4.11). A press that is not on a field keeps the field's focus. The exception is a composer living inside the bar, as on chat, which rides above the keys instead.

Colour is the product's own, no new token. The key radius --len-5 is off the closed radius ramp and is recorded as a quotation of Apple's geometry, not a defect. The keys rise over 0.32s; reduced motion drops the rise.

Sources: ui/kit.html § Onscreen keyboard · inventory.md § 1 (Onscreen keyboard) · HIG · Onscreen keyboards

Rule and anti-rule

Do

0⌫

The field picks the plane: a card number or a phone draws the pad, and Done in the accessory bar is the only way down.

Don’t

An action bar left standing behind the keys. It is still in the tab order, and the moment focus reaches Submit review it is obscured (WCAG 2.4.11). Hide the action bar while the keys are up; never dim it. Do not make the keys real controls either: only Done, and the pad's digits on a numeric field, take a press.
